pr_title: ngcc: fix NgModuleWithProviders issue for aliased IIFE wrapped es2015 classes
pr_body:
In ES2015 IIFE wrapped classes, the identifier that would reference the class
of the NgModule may be an alias variable. Previously the `Esm2015ReflectionHost`
was not able to match this alias to the original class declaration. This resulted
in failing to identify some `ModuleWithProviders` functions in such case.

These IIFE wrapped classes were introduced in TypeScript 3.9, which is why
this issue is only recently appearing. Since 9.1.x does not support TS 3.9
there is no reason to backport this commit to that branch.

Fixes #37189

issue_context.title: ModuleWithProviders broken in v10.0.0-next.8
comments: I will dig into why we are not matching `StorageModule_1` to the correct class declaration.

Indeed it is a bug in the Es2105ReflectionHost changes to deal with IIFE wrapped classes.

The `StorageModule_1` identifier is declared as a `var` and so this is not picked up as the “alias declaration” of the “inner declaration”.

I’ll put together a fix tomorrow.
Basically, when given the alias `StorageModule_1` the host is finding the inner class "expression" instead of the outer class "declaration".
